reference_sql:
WITH promo AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT promo_id, start_date, end_date - start_date + 1 AS days
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), during AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units, SUM(ol.line_discount_eur) AS discount
  FROM promo p
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
), baseline AS (
  -- one row per promotion with a baseline sale
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND p.start_date - s.order_date BETWEEN 1 AND p.days
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
)
SELECT p.promo_id, COALESCE(d.discount, 0) AS discount_eur,
  COALESCE(d.units, 0) - COALESCE(b.units, 0) AS extra_units,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.units, 0) - COALESCE(b.units, 0) > 0
    THEN ROUND(COALESCE(d.discount, 0) / (COALESCE(d.units, 0) - COALESCE(b.units, 0)), 2) END AS discount_per_extra_unit
FROM promo p
LEFT JOIN during d ON d.promo_id = p.promo_id
LEFT JOIN baseline b ON b.promo_id = p.promo_id

WITH promo AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT promo_id, start_date, end_date - start_date + 1 AS days
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), sums AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT p.promo_id,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.line_discount_eur), 0) FROM order_lines ol WHERE ol.promo_id = p.promo_id) AS discount_eur,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity), 0) FROM order_lines ol WHERE ol.promo_id = p.promo_id)
    - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.units), 0)
       FROM promotion_products pp
       JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
       WHERE pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
         AND p.start_date - s.order_date BETWEEN 1 AND p.days) AS extra_units
  FROM promo p
)
SELECT promo_id, discount_eur, extra_units,
  CASE WHEN extra_units > 0 THEN ROUND(discount_eur / extra_units, 2) END AS discount_per_extra_unit
FROM sums

solver.query:
WITH promo AS (
  SELECT promo_id, promo_type, discount_pct, start_date, CAST(end_date - start_date + 1 AS INTEGER) AS days
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), d AS (
  SELECT ol.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS rev,
         SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS mar, SUM(ol.line_discount_eur) AS disc
  FROM order_lines ol JOIN sales s ON s.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id
  WHERE ol.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promo)
  GROUP BY ol.promo_id
), b AS (
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS rev,
         SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS mar
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
   AND s.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date - p.days AND p.start_date - 1
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
), x AS (
  SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_type, p.discount_pct, p.days,
         COALESCE(d.units,0) AS pu, COALESCE(b.units,0) AS bu,
         COALESCE(d.rev,0) AS pr, COALESCE(b.rev,0) AS br,
         COALESCE(d.mar,0) AS pm, COALESCE(b.mar,0) AS bm,
         COALESCE(d.disc,0) AS disc
  FROM promo p LEFT JOIN d ON d.promo_id=p.promo_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.promo_id=p.promo_id
)
SELECT promo_id, disc AS discount_eur, pu - bu AS extra_units, CASE WHEN pu - bu > 0 THEN ROUND(disc / (pu - bu), 2) END AS discount_per_extra_unit FROM x
